items.comment: Second paragraph repeats 'extending'/'class' twice in one sentence ('Extending this class allows a function value to be defined by extending a class rather than the trait'), reading as slightly circular. Could tighten to 'A function value can be defined by extending this class rather than the [[scala.Function12]] trait.' Not a blocker, and it matches the wording used in sibling files (AbstractFunction11, etc.), so it's a systemic pattern rather than an error specific to this file.
Accurate and consistent with Function12's own tparam docs.
